donor.role: ImageGen surface pixels only; never geometry or alpha
donor.normalization: ImageOps.fit to 1608x978 with centered LANCZOS crop

mask.outside_contract: source RGB and alpha byte-identical wherever final mask is zero

shading.purpose: preserve accepted page folds, contact shadows and stacked-page depth while donor supplies color and microtexture

output.alpha: byte-identical copy from accepted V3 source
output.geometry: byte-identical outside the fixed paper mask; no resampling of the source frame
output.runtime_layout: reuse existing ChatV3 nine-slice cuts, 440x320 assembly and separate Tab/Input atlases
